title: Tokensoft Alternative: Post-Raise Token Allocations
content_html:
You raised a token sale and now you have a list of investors, vesting dates, and multiple wallets. You need a way to see every allocation, run the vesting schedule, and send payouts without logging into three different tools. Doing this by hand costs time and creates errors.

Why the post‑raise stage matters

The token sale itself is only the first step. After the raise you must track who owns what, enforce lock‑ups, and distribute rewards or dividends. If you miss a vesting date, investors may lose trust. If you send a payout to the wrong address, you may lose funds. A single view that connects all EVM wallets and MultiversX accounts can stop these problems.

How a Tokensoft alternative can cover the whole lifecycle

A Tokensoft alternative focuses on the period after the sale. It lets you:

  • Import the list of investors directly from your sale contract.
  • Assign each investor to an address on any EVM chain or on MultiversX.
  • Set up vesting rules that match your tokenomics.
  • Run automated distributions on the schedule you defined.
  • Generate reports that show each investor’s balance, earned rewards, and upcoming unlocks.

All of these actions happen in a non‑custodial interface. Your funds never leave the wallets you control. The platform only reads the blockchain data and writes the transactions you approve.

Step‑by‑step workflow

1. Connect your wallets, Link Metamask, Ledger, or any other EVM wallet and your MultiversX wallet. The connection is read‑only until you sign a transaction.
2. Upload the investor list, Paste a CSV file that includes the investor address, token amount, and vesting start date.
3. Define the vesting schedule, Choose a cliff, a linear release, or a custom schedule. The tool will calculate the exact amount that unlocks each month.
4. Run a distribution, When a payout is due, review the list of recipients, approve the transaction in your wallet, and the platform will broadcast the transfers.
5. Export a report, Download a PDF or CSV that shows each investor’s current holdings, vested amount, and future unlocks. Share the report with your community to keep transparency high.

Benefits of using a single dashboard

  • Less manual work, You no longer need to copy data between spreadsheets and separate wallet apps.
  • Fewer mistakes, The platform checks that each address belongs to the correct chain before sending a transaction.
  • Clear compliance, The reports give you a paper trail that can be shown to auditors or regulators.
  • All‑chain coverage, EVM chains and MultiversX are supported, so you do not need separate tools for each network.

Real‑world example

A launchpad that sold a token on Ethereum and later added a MultiversX bridge needed to manage vesting for 2,500 investors. Using a Tokensoft alternative, the team linked their Metamask and MultiversX wallets, imported the investor CSV, and set a 12‑month linear vesting. The platform sent the first monthly distribution automatically, and the team exported a report that showed each investor’s balance on both chains. The launchpad saved dozens of hours and avoided a missed payout that could have hurt its reputation.

Closing thoughts

If you have finished a token sale and want to keep control of allocations, vesting, and payouts across EVM and MultiversX wallets, a Tokensoft alternative gives you a single place to do it all. You might want to check out cryptool for a non‑custodial way to manage the post‑raise investor lifecycle.
